slices.title: Budget ledger and stop rules

slices.title: Attended auto-continue
slices.summary: Adds the pure goal-pump state machine in the SPA (wait/countdown/send/stop with closed stop reasons, hidden-tab pause), the Keep going toggle, countdown and Stop on the goal bar, and wires it to continueGoal(). Server side, ClaimGoalTurn gains pending-decision refusal and a rate guard, and InvokeRequest gains goal_auto (marks runs.metadata.goal_auto, grants nothing). No proto change and no migration; the toggle is hidden unless the gateway reports auto_continue_available. Round B C-B5 adds a test: a goal turn waiting on browser_human_assist counts as a running turn for max_turns, is not judged, and a takeover expiry reaches the goal as a failed turn, never met.
slices.remaining: Owner decisions D4 (SPA drives attended continuation) and D5 (any pending approval/question/plan/park stops the pump; server enforces); round B lists S4 as startable once accepted and orders it after EP-1 S1.

decisions_defaults.D4: The SPA sends the next turn with a 5 s visible countdown and Stop; closing the tab stops the goal; hidden tab never sends.
decisions_defaults.D5: Every pause stops the pump; the pump never approves anything; ClaimGoalTurn refuses with thread_goal_pending_decision when an approval, question, proposed plan or parked run exists; max 30 claims per goal per hour.
